```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)
options(scipen = 999)
```


```{r}
df <- read_csv("Dataset SPBU.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
df <- df %>%
  rename(
    Interarrival_Time = `Inter-Arrival Time (detik)`,
    Service_Time      = `Service Time (detik)`
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Interarrival_Time), !is.na(Service_Time))

```


```{r}
T_antar    <- mean(df$Interarrival_Time)
T_layanan  <- mean(df$Service_Time)

lambda <- 1 / T_antar     # laju kedatangan
mu     <- 1 / T_layanan   # laju pelayanan
rho    <- lambda / mu      # utilisasi
```


```{r}
mm1_results <- function(lambda, mu) {
  rho <- lambda / mu
  
  if (rho >= 1) {
    return(data.frame(
      Pesan = "Sistem TIDAK stabil (rho >= 1). Metrik tidak terhingga."
    ))
  }
  
  P0 <- 1 - rho
  Lq <- (lambda^2) / (mu * (mu - lambda))
  Wq <- Lq / lambda
  L  <- lambda / (mu - lambda)
  W  <- L / lambda
  
  data.frame(
    Metrik = c(
      "Lambda (motor/jam)",
      "Mu (motor/jam)",
      "Utilisasi (rho)",
      "Prob. Sistem Kosong (P0)",
      "Panjang Antrian (Lq)",
      "Waktu Tunggu Antrian (Wq - detik)",
      "Waktu Total Sistem (W - detik)",
      "Waktu Tunggu (Wq - menit)",
      "Waktu Total (W - menit)"
    ),
    Nilai = c(
      lambda * 3600,
      mu * 3600,
      rho,
      P0,
      Lq,
      Wq,
      W,
      Wq / 60,
      W / 60
    )
  )
}

```


```{r}
hasil <- mm1_results(lambda, mu)
print(hasil)
```

```{r}
# 1. Histogram Interarrival Time
ggplot(df, aes(x = Interarrival_Time)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "#1F77B4", color = "white") +
  labs(
    title = "Distribusi Interarrival Time (detik)",
    x = "Interarrival Time (detik)",
    y = "Frekuensi"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# 2. Histogram Service Time
ggplot(df, aes(x = Service_Time)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "#D62728", color = "white") +
  labs(
    title = "Distribusi Service Time (detik)",
    x = "Service Time (detik)",
    y = "Frekuensi"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# 3. Scatter Plot
ggplot(df, aes(x = Interarrival_Time, y = Service_Time)) +
  geom_point(color = "#9467BD", size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(
    title = "Interarrival vs Service Time",
    x = "Interarrival Time (detik)",
    y = "Service Time (detik)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# --- 1. Ambil nilai rho & Lq dari mm1_results() ------------------------------
rho_actual <- hasil$Nilai[hasil$Metrik == "Utilisasi (rho)"]
Lq_actual  <- hasil$Nilai[hasil$Metrik == "Panjang Antrian (Lq)"]

# --- 2. Hitung rho per baris (untuk menentukan range aktual) -----------------
df <- df %>%
  mutate(rho_i = Service_Time / Interarrival_Time)

rho_min <- min(df$rho_i, na.rm = TRUE)
rho_max <- max(df$rho_i, na.rm = TRUE)

# --- 3. Buat kurva teori M/M/1 dalam range aktual ----------------------------
rho_seq <- seq(rho_min, rho_max, length.out = 500)
Lq_seq  <- (rho_seq^2) / (1 - rho_seq)

df_curve <- data.frame(
  rho = rho_seq,
  Lq  = Lq_seq
)

# --- 4. Data titik aktual -----------------------------------------------------
df_point <- data.frame(
  rho = rho_actual,
  Lq  = Lq_actual
)

# --- 5. Plot ------------------------------------------------------------------
ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = df_curve, aes(x = rho, y = Lq),
            color = "blue", linewidth = 1.3) +
  geom_point(data = df_point, aes(x = rho, y = Lq),
             color = "red", size = 4) +
  labs(
    title = "Kurva M/M/1 Berdasarkan Rentang Rho Aktual + Titik Aktual",
    x = "Utilisasi (rho)",
    y = "Panjang Antrian (Lq)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
